newsitem.title: USA: Clinton confers with his budget negotiators.
newsitem.headline: Clinton confers with his budget negotiators.

text.p: Facing "very large differences" with Congress on key budget issues, President Clinton met Friday with his negotiators to discuss strategy.

Clinton met at the White House Friday morning with Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin, White House Chief of Staff Erskine Bowles and congressional liason John Hilley to discuss "their marching orders" in budget talks with Republican leaders, Press Secretary Mike McCurry said.
McCurry said the White House and congressional leadership have "narrowed the preception of their differences" but that "on very important issues there are very large differences that remain."
